messages:
alex.s: Quick sync — I ran a light analysis on the last 12 weeks of incidents and see three repeating themes: autoscaler thrash on burst traffic, cold-start latency on low-tier models, and cache eviction storms during nightly ETL. Want a focused follow-up thread to assign owners and timelines. TL;DR in the next message.
marie_ops: TL;DR?
alex.s: 1) Autoscaler thrash -> causes timeouts and cascading 429s. 2) Cold-starts -> affects latency SLO for Dedicated burst lanes. 3) Cache eviction storms -> token cost spikes and error cascades.
jamal_eng: Good catch. Do you have counts/numbers?
alex.s: Autoscaler-related incidents: 9 in last 12w, median recovery 7m, peak amplification after deploys. Cold-starts: 14 latency regressions, 60% on models pinned to small pools. Cache storms: 5 incidents, correlated with nightly batch jobs + cache TTL misconfig.
sophia_sre: Adding context — 3 of the autoscaler events had conflicting pod affinity rules in the k8s manifest, which slowed node packing.
lia_pm: We should prioritize by customer impact. Which of these hit hosted API customers vs Dedicated?
tariq_reliability: Autoscaler thrash affected Hosted (prod) and 2 Dedicated tenants; cold-starts mostly Dedicated small-pool customers; cache storms were internal (billing spikes) but also bumped a few tenant tails.
marie_ops: Proposal: create three remediation tracks, each with an owner, initial 2-week remediation plan, and a follow-up checkpoint in 30 days. Owners volunteered?
jamal_eng: I can own autoscaler track w/ @sophia_sre for runbook updates. Initial plan: reproduce with synthetic bursts, tune scaleDown/scaleUp thresholds, add stabilization window, and add pre-warm hook for critical routes. Deliverable: config PR + canary in staging in 10 business days.
sophia_sre: I'll update incident runbooks and add a postmortem checklist for deploys that touch autoscaler configs. Also add a monitoring alarm for repeated scale events in 5m windows.
lia_pm: I'll flag the affected customers and prepare communication templates. Liaise with sales for any SLA credits.
tariq_reliability: For cold-starts, I can own. Plan: quantify cold-start tail by model/profile, enable warm-pool for high-risk models, and evaluate microVM warmers. Deliverable: metric dashboard + pilot for 2 models in 12 days.
alex.s: Cache eviction storms — who's in?
marie_ops: ops can pair with eng infra. Short plan: audit TTLs, add backpressure on nightly ETL write rates, and set a hard eviction cap per-tenant. Create gating tests to run in QA. Target: config + test in 14 days.
jamal_eng: I'll open a ticket for autoscaler config changes: JIRA RED-8421. Include roll-forward and rollback steps.
sophia_sre: Runbook entries: RM-174 (autoscaler), RM-175 (cold-starts), RM-176 (cache-eviction). I'll attach links after this thread.
inc-bot: Incident bot: created follow-up tasks: RED-8421 (autoscaler), RED-8422 (cold-start pilot), RED-8423 (cache audit) assigned to respective owners.
lia_pm: Can we set firm checkpoints? I suggest a 30-day review meeting + weekly async updates in #incidents.
tariq_reliability: Agree. I'll post weekly progress notes. First checkpoint: 1781839367 (30 days).
marie_ops: Risk table idea: map each remediation to potential regressions (deploy risk, config risk, perf risk) so SRE can gate. I'll draft and post by EOD.
jamal_eng: Quick note: for autoscaler we should add a synthetic traffic job in CI that runs on every infra config PR. Command stub: ```bash
# run a 2m synthetic burst against staging
./tools/synth_burst --target staging --rate 500 --duration 120
```
lia_pm: Customer comms template: short apology, what happened, what we're doing, ETA for fix, contact. I'll drop draft in #customer-success and link it here.
sophia_sre: Risk mitigation until fix: 1) enable conservative scaleDown on prod, 2) pin critical customers to reserved nodes for next 2 weeks, 3) increase trace sampling for burst windows.
tariq_reliability: Also recommend we create a recurring quarterly 'pattern audit' in our ops calendar so this doesn't pile up.
alex.s: Thanks everyone. Action items summary (I'll paste into the ticket): - Autoscaler (owner: jamal_eng + sophia_sre) -> PR + canary in 10bd -> RED-8421. - Cold-starts (owner: tariq_reliability) -> pilot warm pool + dashboard -> RED-8422. - Cache eviction (owner: marie_ops + infra) -> TTL audit + backpressure -> RED-8423. Checkpoint: 1781839367 (30d). Weekly status in #incidents.
marie_ops: I'll own the weekly status post and update the ticket links.
lia_pm: Noted. If anyone needs E2E test resources ping me — can provision short-lived nodes for testing.
jamal_eng: I'll post the first update by EOD tomorrow with initial repro results.
sophia_sre: I'll attach the runbook drafts before the first checkpoint.
inc-bot: Incident bot: reminder set for 1781839367 (30d follow-up).
alex.s: Closing the thread for now — please keep all progress updates in the RED tickets and cc this thread if you post anything public. :thumbsup:
